description: Every transfer reviewed, every large payment queried, every new account a three-week process with extra documents. Individually minor, cumulatively a permanent surcharge on an ordinary financial life.
money_note: Annual, in fees, spreads and lost opportunity.
energy_note: A percentage taken off the top of your whole life.

aspect: Credit builds slower or not at all
description: Restricted products, refused cards, higher rates. Ten years later the mortgage is more expensive or unavailable, which is a six-figure difference produced by a nationality.
energy_note: A worse mortgage for a worse birthplace.

aspect: Business becomes impossible at the payments layer
description: A consultant cannot invoice, a shop cannot take card payments, a startup cannot get a merchant account. The entrepreneurship the host country says it wants is blocked at the plumbing.
energy_note: Allowed to work, not allowed to be paid.
